title: Surface Similar Target: Arthur's Bakery Delivery
text: Arthur was a patient in a psychiatric hospital where the matron managed the ward. Arthur disliked bedroom inspections, but today the bakery delivered a special cake for the recreation hall. The matron asked Arthur to clean the dining tables before the cake was served. Arthur ate a large meal and felt tired. While the matron conducted routine bedroom checks elsewhere in the facility, Arthur took a nap in his room. By the time Arthur woke up, the party had concluded, the tables had been cleared by staff, and the cake had already been eaten.
